verdict.rationale: Prefix caching is a fair performance question for an on-device inference SDK and engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions prefix, prompt, or KV caching for repeated prompts. System prompts, chat history, NPU acceleration and throughput benchmarks are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
